question.question: How do tea/coins/bags enter or leave item tracks, what is track capacity, and can damaged face-up items pay actions?

expected.expected_answer: Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel move to empty matching track space when able; each track capacity three. Exhaust track item into Satchel. Damaged items cannot pay actions even if face up; exhaustion requires face-up undamaged item.

source_passages.section: Actions — Vagabond (9; V.1–3), tea/coin/bag tracks and item handling
source_passages.quotation: Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel immediately move to empty matching track space if possible; each track holds at most three of its type. Exhausting an item on track sends it to Satchel. Boots/swords/crossbows/torch/hammers are gained face up in Satchel. Damaging an item sends it to Damaged box **without changing its face**. One hit damages one undamaged item of your choice; ignore excess hits when none remain.

source_passages.section: Actions — Vagabond (9; V.1–3), paying for actions
source_passages.quotation: To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.

answer.ruling: Face-up tea, coins, and bags in Satchel immediately move to an empty matching track space if possible; each type’s track holds at most three. If an item on a track is exhausted, it goes to Satchel. Other item types are gained face up in Satchel.

answer.ruling: Damaging an item sends it to the Damaged box without changing its face. To pay for an action, an item must be face up and undamaged; a damaged face-up item cannot pay.
